title: Cazuela's additions
description: Structures, items, ores. A mod that enriches the game with a variety of additions to make the world feel more alive. A mod targeted for modpacks.
body:
![Mushroom house structure](https://pbs.twimg.com/media/GuQQjc8WcAA2Nab?format=jpg&name=small)

📖 **About** 📖

**Cazuela's additions** is a mod focused just on adding random little stuff that could fit in basically most modpacks to enrich the world. Structures, items, ores. 

**Version 0.0.2 of this mod includes:**

**-Structures:**
-    Mushroom house (overworld)
-    Blue dungeon (overworld)
-    Savanna cargo (overworld)




**-Blocks:**
-    Salt block (generates naturally)
-    Crystallized salt block (generates naturally)




**-Items:**
-    Salt
-    Salt crystal
-    Salt shaker
-    Salty steak
-    Salty porkchop
-    Salty chicken
-    Salty mutton
-    Salty rabbit
-    Salty cod
-    Salty salmon
-    Salty potato
-    Salty golden carrot
